loss.label: tab:abl_perda
loss.caption: Loss function ablation on the first-generation models ($wF_{\max}$, validation set). Architecture fixed at MLP with \texttt{max} pooling; the only varying factor is the objective. AVG is the arithmetic mean over the three ontologies.

gen1_arch.label: tab:abl_arquitetura
gen1_arch.caption: Vector architecture and pooling ablation on the first-generation models ($wF_{\max}$, validation set). Loss fixed at \textsc{ProteinLoss}. \texttt{raw} feeds the full score profile against the training set; \texttt{max} and \texttt{avg} pool it beforehand. Best per column in bold, second best underlined.

gen1_backbone.label: tab:abl_backbone
gen1_backbone.caption: Vision backbone ablation on the first-generation models ($wF_{\max}$, validation set). The input is the outer absolute-difference image of the score profile. Loss fixed at \textsc{ProteinLoss}. Best per column in bold, second best underlined.

hops_vector.label: tab:sweep_hops_vector
hops_vector.caption: Propagation depth sweep, vector head ($wF_{\max}$, validation set, $\alpha = 0.5$). Best per column in bold, second best underlined.

alpha_vector.label: tab:sweep_alpha_vector
alpha_vector.caption: Mixing coefficient sweep, vector head ($wF_{\max}$, validation set) at the best depth of each ontology (BP $T=1$, CC $T=2$, MF $T=0$). \textit{n/a}: inapplicable by construction, since at $T=0$ the propagation operator is the identity and $\alpha$ multiplies nothing. The AVG column averages BP and CC, the two ontologies with a coefficient to sweep. Best per column in bold, second best underlined.

hops_vision.label: tab:sweep_hops_vision
hops_vision.caption: Propagation depth sweep, vision head ($wF_{\max}$, validation set, $\alpha = 0.5$). Best per column in bold, second best underlined.

alpha_vision.label: tab:sweep_alpha_vision
alpha_vision.caption: Mixing coefficient sweep, vision head ($wF_{\max}$, validation set) at the best depth of each ontology (BP $T=7$, CC $T=6$, MF $T=0$). \textit{n/a}: inapplicable by construction, as in Table~\ref{tab:sweep_alpha_vector}. The AVG column averages BP and CC. Best per column in bold, second best underlined.

gnn.label: tab:gnn_gcn_gat
gnn.caption: End-to-end graph representation learning ($wF_{\max}$, validation set). Both encoders consume the same graph and the same ProtT5 node attributes, and their trainable transformations are optimized end to end. GAT additionally learns attention coefficients, whereas GCN uses fixed degree-normalized edge weights. Best per column in bold, second best underlined.

dedup.label: tab:dedup
dedup.caption: Edge deduplication regime ($wF_{\max}$, validation set). Each cell is the champion of its family under that regime, selected by validation $wF_{\max}$. $\Delta$ is $\max$ minus $\mathrm{sum}$ on the AVG column, in percentage points.

early_best.label: tab:early_fusion
early_best.caption: Early fusion, best configuration of each cell ($wF_{\max}$, validation set). Each entry is the best of the four provenance and source combinations of Table~\ref{tab:early_grid}. Unless marked, the winner is the embedding trained with a vector head combined with the hyperparameters of the vector route; $^{\mathrm{v}}$ marks a cell won by the embedding trained with a \emph{vision} head, and $^{\mathrm{s}}$ a cell won by the hyperparameters of the \emph{vision} route. Best per column in bold, second best underlined.

early_grid.label: tab:early_grid
early_grid.caption: Early fusion with the GCN encoder: the provenance and source axes crossed ($wF_{\max}$, validation set). \emph{Provenance} is the head with which the consumed GNN embedding was trained; \emph{source} is the route whose depth and mixing coefficient the fixed branch uses. Best per column and head in bold.

late.label: tab:late_fusion
late.caption: Late fusion strategies ($wF_{\max}$, validation set). Each rule combines the probability matrices of the fixed-propagation and end-to-end routes, both already trained. Best per column in bold, second best underlined.

vector_vs_vision.label: tab:vetor_visao_ontologia
vector_vs_vision.caption: Vector versus vision prediction head across the four experimental stages, per ontology ($wF_{\max}$, validation set). Each cell is the champion of that head in that stage and ontology; the configurations are named in Table~\ref{tab:vetor_visao_avg}. The winning head is in bold.

test_BP.label: tab:confronto_bp
test_BP.caption: Comparison against the reimplemented literature baselines in Biological Process (BP), test set. Six metrics; $S_{\min}$ is in bits and lower is better, all others are percentages and higher is better.

test_CC.label: tab:confronto_cc
test_CC.caption: Comparison against the reimplemented literature baselines in Cellular Component (CC), test set. Six metrics; $S_{\min}$ is in bits and lower is better, all others are percentages and higher is better.

test_MF.label: tab:confronto_mf
test_MF.caption: Comparison against the reimplemented literature baselines in Molecular Function (MF), test set. Six metrics; $S_{\min}$ is in bits and lower is better, all others are percentages and higher is better.

cost.label: tab:custo
cost.caption: Computational cost by model family, measured on the RTX A5500 ($147$ runs). Median seconds per epoch is the speed of the family; median hours per run folds in how many epochs each family needed before early stopping. Epochs is the median number of epochs actually executed, which exceeds the selected epoch of Table~\ref{tab:ape_custo} because training continues through the twenty epochs of early-stopping patience that follow the best one. VRAM is the peak of the family. Lowest value in bold for the three cost columns.

isolated_vs_connected.label: tab:degree_isolated_connected
isolated_vs_connected.caption: Performance on isolated versus connected proteins ($wF_{\max}$, test set). A protein is isolated when its degree in the thresholded graph ($dedup = \max$) is zero: $3{,}421$ of $9{,}221$ in BP ($37.1\%$), $3{,}188$ of $9{,}292$ in CC ($34.3\%$) and $2{,}553$ of $7{,}864$ in MF ($32.5\%$). $\Delta$ is connected minus isolated, in percentage points. Best per column in bold, second best underlined.

degree_f1_BP.label: tab:degree_f1_bp
degree_f1_BP.caption: Mean per-protein $F_1$ by connectivity degree band, BP ontology (test set; the routes are those of Table~\ref{tab:rotas_conectividade}). Best route per band in bold, second best underlined. Degree is measured on the full thresholded graph.

degree_f1_CC.label: tab:degree_f1_cc
degree_f1_CC.caption: Mean per-protein $F_1$ by connectivity degree band, CC ontology (test set; the routes are those of Table~\ref{tab:rotas_conectividade}). Best route per band in bold, second best underlined. Degree is measured on the full thresholded graph.

degree_f1_MF.label: tab:degree_f1_mf
degree_f1_MF.caption: Mean per-protein $F_1$ by connectivity degree band, MF ontology (test set; the routes are those of Table~\ref{tab:rotas_conectividade}). Best route per band in bold, second best underlined; \emph{ProtT5 only} and \emph{Fixed + vec.} are the same run in this ontology. Degree is measured on the full thresholded graph.

graph_gain_by_degree.label: tab:degree_graph_gain
graph_gain_by_degree.caption: Gain of the best graph-consuming route over the graph-free $T=0$ control, by connectivity degree band (mean per-protein $F_1$, test set, percentage points). The bracket names the route that attains it: \textsc{f} fixed propagation, \textsc{g} end-to-end GNN, \textsc{h} early fusion. In MF the fixed-propagation champion is $T=0$ and therefore identical to the control, so it is excluded from the maximum in that ontology.

degree_correlation.label: tab:degree_correlation
degree_correlation.caption: Rank correlation between connectivity degree and per-protein $F_1$ (test set; the routes are those of Table~\ref{tab:rotas_conectividade}). $\rho$ is Spearman's rank correlation between degree and per-protein $F_1$; $\tau$ is the decision threshold that maximizes the mean per-protein $F_1$ of that model on this partition; $F_1$ is that mean, over all proteins of the partition. Best $F_1$ per ontology in bold, second best underlined.

coverage.label: tab:cobertura
coverage.caption: Prediction coverage of the test split by method family. A protein is covered when the method can produce a prediction for it; methods that consume only the interaction network cannot score a protein absent from their network. The test partition holds $9{,}221$ proteins in BP, $9{,}292$ in CC and $7{,}864$ in MF.

corpus.label: tab:cafa5
corpus.caption: Number of proteins in the ontology-specific training, validation, and test subsets, together with the number of retained GO terms.

label_space.label: tab:rotulos
label_space.caption: Characterization of the retained label space, computed on the training subset of each ontology.

graph_topology.label: tab:grafo
graph_topology.caption: Topology of the ontology-specific interaction networks, induced over the union of the training, validation, and test proteins. Degree denotes the number of distinct neighbors, so that the reported values do not depend on the deduplication strategy adopted for the edge weights.

multiplicity.label: tab:multiplicidade
multiplicity.caption: Relationship between the number of evidence records reported for a protein pair and the mean combined score of the pairs in that group, over the $791{,}011$ distinct pairs of the inherited file.

hyperparams.label: tab:ape_hp
hyperparams.caption: Optimization settings of the final second-generation campaign. Values marked ``varies'' are part of the search space declared in Section~\ref{sec:met_espaco}. The first generation and the adapted comparative configurations use the settings documented separately below and in Appendix~\ref{ape:comparativos}.

fusion_grid.label: tab:ape_fusao_grade
fusion_grid.caption: Search grid of the late-fusion coefficients. The same grid is applied to the three ontologies. The last column counts the configurations each rule contributes to the search.

fusion_selected.label: tab:ape_fusao_sel
fusion_selected.caption: Late-fusion coefficients selected on the validation partition, per ontology. The coefficients of the term-specific and protein-specific rules are also the ones the combined rule inherits.

cost_runs.label: tab:ape_custo
cost_runs.caption: Measured cost of the final second-generation campaign. The first five rows aggregate families of runs: peak memory is the maximum over the runs of the family, wall time is the median with the maximum in parentheses, and the selected epoch is the median with the minimum and maximum in brackets. Families that ran on more than one accelerator are reported separately, since wall times are not comparable across cards. The last four rows are individual runs of the learned route on Biological Process, for which each column is that single run. Peak memory is in MiB and wall time in hours.

baselines_cost_coverage.label: tab:ape_custo_comp
baselines_cost_coverage.caption: Measured cost and prediction coverage of the comparative configurations. Coverage is the fraction of the test proteins of each ontology that receive at least one predicted term. Except for the deepNF-derived configuration, which was executed on Google Colab, all runs were executed on the development machine (see Table~\ref{tab:ape_maquinas} for environment details).
